name: Month-end rebalancing flow and turn of the month (RTH only)
source: Harvey, Mazzoleni & Melone (2025), The unintended consequences of rebalancing, NBER w33554
McConnell & Xu (2008); Etula, Rinne, Suominen & Vaittinen (2020, RFS), turn-of-the-month
market: MES (MNQ reported as a diagnostic only)
bond: ZN (10-year note futures) from the hash-checked multi_2019-05-01_2024-12-31 file, volume roll; used only for the signal

data.exam: 2025-01-01..2026-10-21 locked; only via the proctor, with Jason's OK (the exam period is after the paper's sample: the real out-of-sample test)

calendar: NYSE sessions (frozen session-calendar.v1.csv); month = calendar month; L = the last session of the month, L-1, L-2 the two before it; F1..F3 the first three sessions of the next month

T1_rebalance.signal: at the RTH close of session L-3 (last bar before the regular close): rel = MES month-to-date return - ZN month-to-date return, each from the previous month's L RTH close (same rule) to L-3's RTH close, each on its own front contract by volume roll (a roll inside the month chains returns across the roll at the roll day's closes)
T1_rebalance.trade: on each of L-2, L-1 and L: short 1 MES if rel > 0, long 1 MES if rel < 0, from the open of the 08:30 CT bar to the open of the 15:00 CT bar (early closes: to the open of the 12:00 CT bar); rel == 0 or missing -> no trade

T2_turn_of_month.trade: long 1 MES on each of L, F1, F2 and F3, from the open of the 08:30 CT bar to the open of the 15:00 CT bar (early closes: 12:00)

rule.other_days: no trade ($0) and not evaluable for the per-trade statistics; the $/day floor is computed per calendar session of the full practice period (all sessions, zeros included)

costs: L3 = Topstep fees + 4 ticks per round trip (MES 622 cents); L1-L4 reported
luck: matched control: the same trade days and bars with a random direction (500 draws/day, numpy PCG64 seeded [20261029, root(MES=2,MNQ=1), yyyymmdd, 13]); daily control = mean of draws
diagnostics: T2 vs always-long MES on all other sessions (is the turn of the month special?)
per-year net; MNQ on the same rules; the hit rate of T1 by sign of rel

gates.beats_luck: one-sided paired stationary bootstrap vs the matched control over trade days (workbench inference), at the family Sidak bar for 2 trials: alpha = 0.0253 each
gates.floor: net >= $1.00 per calendar session at L3 averaged over all sessions (a sparse rule: equivalent to >= ~$7 per trade day for T1, ~$5.5 for T2), AND net per trade >= $5.00
gates.advance: a pass is a candidate for exam check #2 (after-publication data), only with Jason's OK; no prop-simulator claim from 2019-2024 alone
gates.no_retuning: no other parameters; failures are recorded as is

caveat_known_in_advance: 2019-2024 lies mostly inside the papers' samples, so practice is a replication, not out-of-sample. About 200 trade days per trial: low power. T2 also earns market beta (2019-2024 rose).
honesty: 2 distinct workbench trials on MES (+ MNQ diagnostics, not gated)
